description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling daemon actions and responses, including emitting JSON payloads, classifying hints, creating service snapshots, and managing daemon service installation and status.

methods.name: emitDaemonActionJson
methods.description: Serializes and writes a DaemonActionResponse payload as JSON using the runtime.

methods.name: classifyDaemonHintText
methods.description: Classifies a hint text string into a specific DaemonHintKind based on its content.

methods.name: buildDaemonHintItems
methods.description: Creates an array of DaemonHintItem objects from an array of hint strings.

methods.name: buildDaemonServiceSnapshot
methods.description: Constructs a snapshot object representing the current state of a GatewayService.

methods.name: createNullWriter
methods.description: Creates a Writable stream that discards all written data.

methods.name: createDaemonActionContext
methods.description: Creates context objects for handling daemon actions, including stdout, warnings, emit, and fail functions.

methods.name: installDaemonServiceAndEmit
methods.description: Attempts to install a daemon service, then emits its status or handles errors.
